lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sequence of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the pectoral fin insertion to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, showing a sharp transition from high-intensity dorsal pixels to low-intensity ventral pixels, indicating a structural ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 5-7 distinct spots visible on the lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the primary flank patterning.
